system.description:
Range: Self

Area: 10-space-radius

Legend has it that the Blue Spirit's spells are so masterful that no creature can unmake them. It lends a portion of this mastery to you and your allies.

As an Action, you can bolster the magic of yourself and your allies.

Until the start of your next turn, the Complexity to Counteract any spells cast by yourself or allies within 10 spaces of you increases by a number equal to your Soul.

You can spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.
